description: This file defines the FilterParams class used for encapsulating filtering parameters such as sorting order, limit, and offset within the OrangeHRM system. It includes getter and setter methods with validation for sort order and constants for default limit and offset values.

classes.name: FilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating filtering parameters such as sort order, field, limit, and offset, used for querying operations in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the current sort order, either 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order after validating that it is either 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'. Throws SearchParamException on invalid input.

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Returns the field used for sorting, or null if not set.

methods.name: setSortField
methods.description: Sets the field used for sorting.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of results to fetch, default is 50.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of results to fetch.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset from the beginning of the result set, default is 0.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the result set.
